about: Shared cross-language pin for the merged exporters' one-IfcRelAggregates-parent rule (#5471 TypeScript, #5727 Rust).

Each case merges `models` (DATA lines of IFC4 files, merged in order, schema IFC4) with both MergedExporter (packages/export/src/merged-single-parent.parity.test.ts) and export_merged_models (rust/export/tests/merged_single_parent_parity.rs).

`parents` maps an entity's GlobalId to the GlobalIds of its IfcRelAggregates parents in the output, sorted. Written from IFC's Decomposes SET [0:1] and each case's source, not copied from either exporter's output.
Both exporters must also write no object as a RelatedObjects member of two IfcRelAggregates.

cases.name: issue_5471_pair_shape
cases.why: B's Building unifies with A's; A aggregates it under a Site, B under its Project. B's rel is fully redundant.

cases.name: partial_rel_variant_5727
cases.why: B's rel names the unifying Building AND a proxy that does not unify. The Building must keep only its Site parent; the proxy keeps the (unified) Project as its parent.
